explain.ko: 과거완료(had + 과거분사)는 과거의 어떤 시점보다 더 앞서 일어난 일을 나타냅니다. 'When we arrived, the film had already started.'에서 영화가 시작한 것이 도착보다 먼저입니다. 원인을 설명할 때(She was upset because she had lost her ticket)와 by the time, before, after와 함께 흔히 씁니다. 시간 순서가 이미 분명하면 과거형만 써도 됩니다. 부정은 hadn't, 의문문은 Had you …? 입니다.
explain.en: The past perfect (had + past participle) shows that something happened before another moment in the past. In 'When we arrived, the film had already started', the film started first. It is often used to explain a cause (She was upset because she had lost her ticket) and with by the time, before and after. When the order is already clear, the past simple is enough. The negative is hadn't and the question is Had you …?

head: 용도 / Use

rows: I was late because I had missed the bus.

notes.ko: by the time + 과거형, 주절은 과거완료: By the time I arrived, they had left.
notes.en: By the time + past simple, main clause in the past perfect: By the time I arrived, they had left.

notes.ko: 순서가 분명한 before / after 문장에서는 과거형만 써도 됩니다.
notes.en: With before and after the past simple is also possible when the order is clear.

notes.ko: 과거완료는 모든 인칭에서 had로 같습니다: I had, she had, they had.
notes.en: The past perfect uses had with every subject: I had, she had, they had.

prompt.ko: 계획과 다르게 흘러간 하루를 3문장으로 써 보세요: 도착했을 때 이미 일어난 일, 전에 해 본 적 없던 일, 그 후에 한 일.
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences about a day that did not go to plan: what had already happened when you arrived, something you had never done before, and what you did afterwards.

task.model: By the time we arrived, the film had started. I had never been so late before. After I had bought a ticket, I found my seat.

model_trans.en: By the time we arrived, the film had started. I had never been so late before. After I had bought a ticket, I found my seat.
